purpose: FaultFinder exam 2 (Nehasil, CTU Prague): real AHUs no version has seen; scored once for v1.0 and once for any round-2 release, after the round-2 release decision

source.dataset: Nehasil, Versatile AHU fault detection - design, field validation and practical application

split: by unit; every AHU that passes QC is exam (no dev part)

not_mapped.air_temperature__required_value__exahust: room/return setpoint, not a supply-air setpoint

input_gap: No T_oa, T_ma, T_sa_sp, T_zone, fan power or occupancy point exists (100 % outdoor-air units with heat recovery). FaultFinder reads the mapped channels; the missing ones are zero with mask 0. The damper point is an open/closed command, not a modulating position. APAR rules needing T_oa, T_ma or a supply setpoint cannot fire; only R23 (simultaneous heating and cooling) can.

day_rules.unit_day: AHU x local calendar day (5-min rows, local time as logged)
day_rules.fault_day: >= 12 rows (1 h) labelled with a fault in the file
day_rules.normal_day: no row labelled with a fault
day_rules.excluded: 1-11 fault rows; or failing day QC
day_rules.labels: per-row file labels take precedence over the schedule sheet (disagreements listed)
day_rules.qc: temperatures < -45 or > 70 degC -> missing (the induced 150 degC readings become missing); a temperature constant all day -> missing; T_sa in >= 72 of 96 15-min bins; fan on >= 1 h

rows.metric: AHU-day detection AUC (P(fault) log-odds as the score)
false-alarm rate at P = 0.5 on normal days
diagnosis top-1 accuracy on fault days with a mapped class

model_input: released faultfinder_weights.npz through FaultFinder.read_day on processed/<AHU>.parquet (contract columns, time_local), one call per exam day; P from the shipped temperature. A round-2 release is scored the same way with its own shipped calibration. No refit on these data.

baselines.name: APAR rule set, platform dev threshold
baselines.how: shared/building/data/scripts/baselines.py run_score(day frame, dt_s=300) -> score; fault if score > 0.2322 (faults_summary.json ahu_all threshold_dev, fitted on the platform dev runs)

baselines.name: Majority guess (platform dev majority: no fault)
Majority fault class among diagnosable exam days is NOT used (it would read the exam); chance = 1 / number of FaultFinder classes (18)

interval.method: 95 % percentile bootstrap over exam AHUs (all days of a drawn AHU move together)
interval.statistic: model metric minus the best baseline metric on the same resample (best = better point value on the full exam)
interval.verdict: win if the interval is entirely on the good side of zero, loss if entirely on the bad side, tie if it spans zero; n AHUs and n days stated
